import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Decidable test for `g.has_edge u v`. -/
def edgeB (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  (u < g.adj.size) && (g.adj.getD u #[]).contains v

/-- `u` has no predecessor among the nodes of `rem` (in-degree 0 in the induced subgraph). -/
def noPredIn (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  !(rem.any (fun v => edgeB g v u))

/-- Some predecessor of `u` inside `rem` (used only in the cycle-existence proof). -/
def predOf (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) (u : Nat) : Nat :=
  (rem.find? (fun v => edgeB g v u)).getD 0

/-- Kahn's algorithm: repeatedly move a node of in-degree 0 (w.r.t. the remaining
    nodes) from `rem` to the end of `out`.  If no such node exists the remaining
    subgraph has a cycle and we report failure. -/
def topoStep (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (out rem : List Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  match fuel, rem with
  | _, [] => some out
  | 0, _ :: _ => none
  | fuel + 1, r0 :: rs =>
    match (r0 :: rs).find? (noPredIn g (r0 :: rs)) with
    | none => none
    | some u => topoStep g fuel (out ++ [u]) ((r0 :: rs).erase u)

/-- Specification of the result of `topoStep`. -/
def GoodResult (g : TopoGraph) (r : Option (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | some L =>
      L.Nodup ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ L ↔ x < g.adj.size) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < L.length → j < L.length →
        g.has_edge (L.getD i 0) (L.getD j 0) → i < j)
  | none => g.graph_has_cycle
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def topological_sort (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (topoStep graph graph.adj.size [] (List.range graph.adj.size)).map List.toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_postcond (graph : TopoGraph) (result : Option (Array Nat))
    (_ : topological_sort_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma edgeB_iff (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : edgeB g u v = true ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  unfold edgeB TopoGraph.has_edge
  simp

lemma lgetD (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) : l.getD i 0 = l[i] := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h]
  rfl

lemma getD_mem (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) : l.getD i 0 ∈ l := by
  rw [lgetD l i h]
  exact List.getElem_mem h

lemma getD_append_lt (l₁ l₂ : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l₁.length) :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).getD i 0 = l₁.getD i 0 := by
  have h2 : i < (l₁ ++ l₂).length := by simp; omega
  rw [lgetD _ _ h2, lgetD _ _ h, List.getElem_append_left h]

lemma getD_append_len (l₁ : List Nat) (u : Nat) :
    (l₁ ++ [u]).getD l₁.length 0 = u := by
  have h2 : l₁.length < (l₁ ++ [u]).length := by simp
  rw [lgetD _ _ h2]
  simp

lemma idxOf_spec (l : List Nat) (a : Nat) (h : a ∈ l) :
    l.idxOf a < l.length ∧ l.getD (l.idxOf a) 0 = a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b t ih =>
    by_cases hb : b = a
    · subst hb
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      have : (b :: t).idxOf b = 0 := by simp
      rw [this]
      simp [lgetD]
    · have ht : a ∈ t := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd h1.symm hb
        · exact h1
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih ht
      have hidx : (b :: t).idxOf a = t.idxOf a + 1 := by
        simp [List.idxOf_cons, hb]
      refine ⟨by rw [hidx]; simp; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [hidx]
      rw [lgetD _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      rw [lgetD _ _ h1] at h2
      simpa using h2

lemma head?_getD (p : List Nat) (h : 0 < p.length) : p.head? = some (p.getD 0 0) := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => simp [lgetD]

lemma getLast?_getD (p : List Nat) (h : 0 < p.length) :
    p.getLast? = some (p.getD (p.length - 1) 0) := by
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega),
    lgetD _ _ (by omega)]

lemma cycle_from_iter (g : TopoGraph) (f : Nat → Nat) (x : Nat)
    (hedge : ∀ t, g.has_edge (f^[t + 1] x) (f^[t] x))
    (a b : Nat) (hab : a < b) (heq : f^[a] x = f^[b] x) :
    g.graph_has_cycle := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, b = a + k + 1 := ⟨b - a - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨(List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] x), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at hi
    have e1 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] x)).getD i 0 = f^[b - i] x := by
      rw [lgetD _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      simp
    have e2 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] x)).getD (i + 1) 0
        = f^[b - (i + 1)] x := by
      rw [lgetD _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      simp
    rw [e1, e2]
    have h3 : b - i = (b - (i + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [h3]
    exact hedge (b - (i + 1))
  · simp; omega
  · have h1 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] x)).head? = some (f^[b] x) := by
      have hr : b - a + 1 = (b - a) + 1 := rfl
      rw [hr, List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    have h2 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] x)).getLast?
        = some (f^[a] x) := by
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append]
      have : b - (b - a) = a := by omega
      simp [this]
    rw [h1, h2, heq]

lemma cycle_of_no_source (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ rem)
    (hno : ∀ u ∈ rem, ∃ v ∈ rem, g.has_edge v u) : g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hf : ∀ u ∈ rem, predOf g rem u ∈ rem ∧ g.has_edge (predOf g rem u) u := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hev⟩ := hno u hu
    have hev' : edgeB g v u = true := (edgeB_iff g v u).2 hev
    rcases hfind : rem.find? (fun w => edgeB g w u) with _ | v'
    · rw [List.find?_eq_none] at hfind
      exact absurd hev' (by simpa using hfind v hv)
    · have h1 : v' ∈ rem := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfind
      have h2 : edgeB g v' u = true := by
        have := List.find?_some hfind
        simpa using this
      have h3 : predOf g rem u = v' := by simp [predOf, hfind]
      rw [h3]
      exact ⟨h1, (edgeB_iff g v' u).1 h2⟩
  set f := predOf g rem with hfd
  have hiter : ∀ t, f^[t] x ∈ rem := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => simpa using hx
    | succ t iht =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact (hf _ iht).1
  have hedge : ∀ t, g.has_edge (f^[t + 1] x) (f^[t] x) := by
    intro t
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact (hf _ (hiter t)).2
  have hmaps : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range (rem.length + 1), f^[t] x ∈ rem.toFinset := by
    intro t _
    exact List.mem_toFinset.2 (hiter t)
  have hcard : rem.toFinset.card < (Finset.range (rem.length + 1)).card := by
    have h := rem.toFinset_card_le
    simp only [Finset.card_range]
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, -, b, -, hab, heq⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hcard hmaps
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a b with h | h
  · exact cycle_from_iter g f x hedge a b h heq
  · exact cycle_from_iter g f x hedge b a (by omega) heq.symm

lemma topoStep_spec (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ (N : Nat) (rem out : List Nat), rem.length ≤ N →
      (out ++ rem).Nodup →
      (∀ x, x ∈ out ++ rem ↔ x < g.adj.size) →
      (∀ u ∈ out, ∀ v, g.has_edge v u → v ∈ out) →
      (∀ i j, i < out.length → j < out.length →
         g.has_edge (out.getD i 0) (out.getD j 0) → i < j) →
      GoodResult g (topoStep g N out rem) := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro rem out hlen hnd hmem hcl hord
    have hr : rem = [] := by
      cases rem with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a t => simp at hlen
    subst hr
    show GoodResult g (some out)
    exact ⟨by simpa using hnd, by simpa using hmem, hord⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    intro rem out hlen hnd hmem hcl hord
    cases rem with
    | nil =>
      show GoodResult g (some out)
      exact ⟨by simpa using hnd, by simpa using hmem, hord⟩
    | cons r0 rs =>
      have hunf : topoStep g (N + 1) out (r0 :: rs) =
          match (r0 :: rs).find? (noPredIn g (r0 :: rs)) with
          | none => none
          | some u => topoStep g N (out ++ [u]) ((r0 :: rs).erase u) := by
        rw [topoStep]
      rw [hunf]
      rcases hf : (r0 :: rs).find? (noPredIn g (r0 :: rs)) with _ | u
      · show g.graph_has_cycle
        have hnone : ∀ v ∈ (r0 :: rs), ¬ noPredIn g (r0 :: rs) v = true := by
          rw [List.find?_eq_none] at hf
          exact hf
        have hno : ∀ v ∈ (r0 :: rs), ∃ w ∈ (r0 :: rs), g.has_edge w v := by
          intro v hv
          have h := hnone v hv
          simp only [noPredIn, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false, List.any_eq_true] at h
          obtain ⟨w, hw, hew⟩ := h
          exact ⟨w, hw, (edgeB_iff g w v).1 hew⟩
        exact cycle_of_no_source g (r0 :: rs) r0 (by simp) hno
      · have hu : u ∈ (r0 :: rs) := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
        have hup : noPredIn g (r0 :: rs) u = true := by
          have := List.find?_some hf
          simpa using this
        have hnp : ∀ v ∈ (r0 :: rs), ¬ g.has_edge v u := by
          intro v hv he
          have h1 : edgeB g v u = true := (edgeB_iff g v u).2 he
          simp only [noPredIn, Bool.not_eq_true', List.any_eq_false] at hup
          exact absurd h1 (by simpa using hup v hv)
        have hperm : ((out ++ [u]) ++ (r0 :: rs).erase u).Perm (out ++ (r0 :: rs)) := by
          rw [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
          exact List.Perm.append_left out (List.perm_cons_erase hu).symm
        have hnd' : ((out ++ [u]) ++ (r0 :: rs).erase u).Nodup := hperm.nodup_iff.mpr hnd
        have hmem' : ∀ x, x ∈ (out ++ [u]) ++ (r0 :: rs).erase u ↔ x < g.adj.size := by
          intro x
          rw [hperm.mem_iff]
          exact hmem x
        have hlen' : ((r0 :: rs).erase u).length ≤ N := by
          rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hu]
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
          omega
        have huout : u ∉ out := by
          intro h
          exact (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).2.2 u h u hu rfl
        have hcl' : ∀ w ∈ out ++ [u], ∀ v, g.has_edge v w → v ∈ out ++ [u] := by
          intro w hw v he
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hw with hw1 | hw2
          · exact List.mem_append_left _ (hcl w hw1 v he)
          · have hwu : w = u := by simpa using hw2
            subst hwu
            have hvl : v ∉ (r0 :: rs) := fun hv => hnp v hv he
            have hv2 : v ∈ out ++ (r0 :: rs) := (hmem v).2 he.1
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hv2 with h1 | h2
            · exact List.mem_append_left _ h1
            · exact absurd h2 hvl
        have hord' : ∀ i j, i < (out ++ [u]).length → j < (out ++ [u]).length →
            g.has_edge ((out ++ [u]).getD i 0) ((out ++ [u]).getD j 0) → i < j := by
          intro i j hi hj he
          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi hj
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i out.length with hi' | hi'
          · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j out.length with hj' | hj'
            · rw [getD_append_lt _ _ _ hi', getD_append_lt _ _ _ hj'] at he
              exact hord i j hi' hj' he
            · omega
          · have hie : i = out.length := by omega
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j out.length with hj' | hj'
            · rw [hie, getD_append_len, getD_append_lt _ _ _ hj'] at he
              have hjm : out.getD j 0 ∈ out := getD_mem out j hj'
              exact absurd (hcl _ hjm u he) huout
            · have hje : j = out.length := by omega
              rw [hie, hje, getD_append_len] at he
              exact absurd he (hnp u hu)
        exact ih ((r0 :: rs).erase u) (out ++ [u]) hlen' hnd' hmem' hcl' hord'

lemma arr_getD (L : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < L.length) :
    L.toArray.getD i 0 = L.getD i 0 := by
  have h2 : i < L.toArray.size := by simpa using h
  have e1 : L.toArray.getD i 0 = L.toArray[i] := by
    simp [Array.getD, h]
  rw [e1, lgetD L i h]
  simp
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem topological_sort_postcond_satisfied (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) :
    topological_sort_postcond graph (topological_sort graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hspec := topoStep_spec graph graph.adj.size (List.range graph.adj.size) []
    (by simp) (by simp [List.nodup_range]) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
  unfold topological_sort
  rcases hres : topoStep graph graph.adj.size [] (List.range graph.adj.size) with _ | L
  · rw [hres] at hspec
    exact hspec
  · rw [hres] at hspec
    obtain ⟨hnd, hmem, hord⟩ := hspec
    have hperm : L.Perm (List.range graph.adj.size) := by
      apply List.perm_of_nodup_nodup_toFinset_eq hnd (List.nodup_range)
      ext x
      simp [hmem]
    have hlenL : L.length = graph.adj.size := by
      have h := hperm.length_eq
      simpa using h
    have hstrict : ∀ u v, graph.has_edge u v → u ∈ L → v ∈ L →
        L.idxOf u < L.idxOf v := by
      intro u v he hu hv
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := idxOf_spec L u hu
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := idxOf_spec L v hv
      exact hord _ _ h1 h3 (by rw [h2, h4]; exact he)
    have hnocyc : ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle := by
      rintro ⟨p, ⟨hplen, hpath⟩, hp1, hp2⟩
      have hin : ∀ t, t < p.length → p.getD t 0 < graph.adj.size := by
        intro t ht
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (t + 1) p.length with h | h
        · exact (hpath t h).1
        · have h1 : (t - 1) + 1 < p.length := by omega
          have he := hpath (t - 1) h1
          have h2 : t - 1 + 1 = t := by omega
          rw [h2] at he
          exact h_precond _ he.1 _ he.2
      have hmono : ∀ s, s < p.length → L.idxOf (p.getD 0 0) + s ≤ L.idxOf (p.getD s 0) := by
        intro s
        induction s with
        | zero => intro _; omega
        | succ s ihs =>
          intro hs
          have h1 := ihs (by omega)
          have h2 : L.idxOf (p.getD s 0) < L.idxOf (p.getD (s + 1) 0) :=
            hstrict _ _ (hpath s hs) ((hmem _).2 (hin s (by omega)))
              ((hmem _).2 (hin (s + 1) hs))
          omega
      have hlast := hmono (p.length - 1) (by omega)
      have heq : p.getD 0 0 = p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 := by
        have h1 := head?_getD p hplen
        have h2 := getLast?_getD p hplen
        rw [h1, h2] at hp2
        simpa using hp2
      rw [← heq] at hlast
      omega
    refine ⟨hnocyc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [TopoGraph.size, hlenL]
    · intro n hn
      have hnL : n ∈ L := (hmem n).2 (by simpa [TopoGraph.size] using hn)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := idxOf_spec L n hnL
      exact ⟨L.idxOf n, by simpa using h1, by rw [arr_getD L _ h1]; exact h2⟩
    · intro i j hi hj hij
      replace hi : i < L.length := by simpa using hi
      replace hj : j < L.length := by simpa using hj
      rw [arr_getD L i hi, arr_getD L j hj, lgetD _ _ hi, lgetD _ _ hj]
      intro hcon
      exact hij ((List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnd).mp hcon)
    · intro i j hji hi
      replace hi : i < L.length := by simpa using hi
      rw [arr_getD L i hi, arr_getD L j (by omega)]
      intro he
      have := hord i j hi (by omega) he
      omega
  -- !benchmark @end proof
